definitions.explanation: To become greater in amount or degree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勢|いきお}い→勢い：01782_ikioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{増|ま}す。
⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{増|ま}してきた。
⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{増|ま}す。
⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{増|ま}して⟦{走|はし}り{始|はじ}めた→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: It picked up speed and started running.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧につれて、⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}さ→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{増|ま}してくる。
examples.english: As you get older, the importance of health grows.

notes:
{増|ま}す is a godan verb meaning "to increase" or "to grow." Can be transitive or intransitive.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Can be both transitive and intransitive
- Compare: {増|ふ}える (intransitive), {増|ふ}やす (transitive) - more common in everyday speech

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勢|いきお}いを{増|ま}す: to gain momentum
- {重要性|じゅうようせい}を{増|ま}す: to grow in importance
- {速度|そくど}を{増|ま}す: to increase speed
- {輝|かがや}きを{増|ま}す: to shine more brightly

REGISTER:
{増|ま}す is more literary/formal than {増|ふ}える. Common in written language and news.

RELATED:
- {減|へ}る: to decrease (opposite)
- ますます: more and more, increasingly
